title: Add entries to a long document without losing the rest
prompt: map.md has five entries and ends with the line '*End of map.*'. Add two new entries, '## file6.js' and '## file7.js', each with a '**Purpose**' line, above that last line. Do not change or remove anything else.
verify: python3 -c "t=open('map.md').read(); hs=[l for l in t.split(chr(10)) if l.startswith('## ')]; assert hs==['## file%d.js'%i for i in range(1,8)], hs; assert t.rstrip().endswith('*End of map.*'); assert all('Entry %d.'%i in t for i in range(1,6))"
